items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Benny used to put me up on a gate, and I couldn't get down. He used to laugh at me...

ctx.x: Who did? The man or Benny's father?
Benny's father. The man, I don't know what happened to him. I mean, Benny's father. Benny is a tough man, and Benny, don't fool around with him!
